result.keywords: AbstractIn this article, we develop a new adaptive exponentially weighted moving average (AEWMA) control chart that incorporates an auxiliary variable and repetitive sampling for monitoring process location. The proposed scheme blends the memory features of EWMA with auxiliary-information based estimation to improve sensitivity to small and moderate shifts in the process center. The smoothing parameter is updated adaptively through a shift estimator formed from the auxiliary statistic, while the repetitive-sampling rule enhances detection performance under in-control and out-of-control conditions. Run-length characteristics are evaluated by Monte Carlo simulation and compared with several existing EWMA and adaptive memory-type charts. The results indicate that the proposed chart offers balanced protection over a range of location shifts. A numerical example is included to illustrate implementation and interpretation.
result.title: An adaptive auxiliary-variable EWMA chart for monitoring process location
